business_problem: Suffolk County's departments faced seasonal call surges on outdated telephony infrastructure, with more than 600 calls per day, 30-minute waits, and over 70% of calls abandoned during peak property-tax periods.
solution_summary: Working with Google Public Sector and UVS InfoTech, Suffolk County deployed the Civic Oriented Response Assistant (CORA) as an AI-powered first line of constituent service. CORA is built on Google Cloud Contact Center AI and integrated with the county's existing RingCentral telephony environment so callers can receive multilingual support around the clock without requiring a live agent for every request. Gemini platform extends the assistant's intelligence, while Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery support the knowledge and telemetry layers behind the service. Interaction data is streamed into BigQuery dashboards so the IT team can monitor resolution trends and tune workflows continuously. The system automates high-volume, repetitive calls during tax season, routes more complex issues to county staff only when needed, and gives employees more room to focus on deep constituent support rather than backlog triage.

solution_components.name: Contact Center AI (CCAI)
solution_components.role: Runs CORA as the county's conversational front door for multilingual voice interactions and automated workflow handling.

solution_components.name: Gemini platform
solution_components.role: Adds generative AI reasoning that helps CORA understand and resolve more complex resident questions.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Stores content and assets used by the virtual assistant environment.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Captures interaction telemetry for central dashboards used to monitor trends and optimize service performance.

data_flow: Resident calls enter through RingCentral and are answered by CORA on Contact Center AI. Gemini platform helps resolve or route requests, while call telemetry streams into BigQuery dashboards and related assistant content is stored in Google Cloud Storage for ongoing optimization.
business_outcome: Suffolk County reduced waits and backlogs, resolved large portions of inbound traffic automatically, and established a repeatable public-sector model for AI-assisted resident services.
